== Strategy ==

Basically the point is to get out the docking bays with secure route set up and the other sites next to them. While using the mains and droids to help defend.

If your opponent stays away then you drain. If they come to battle you just give them a good beatdown and revive any important characters.

I had an older version of this deck but with all the Esisode 1 cards I was able to improve it.

Comments: I appreciate the comments and made a few changes. However I need Nightfall out to start to be able to utilize my droids. The Hydrponics Stations are only there to make people immune to attrition <3 with the droids. So I just threw in Ardon to add to the force drains at the Hydroponics Stations. I do not need the audience chamber to do this. I also cut two sites and added two Mindful Of The Future cards As well as three Moisture Farmers.

Thankx
